paper_title: Overview of the Cosmic Axion Spin Precession Experiment (CASPEr)
coupling_convention: dimensionless g_an (note: paper plots g_aNN in GeV^-1 which is non-standard)
notes: Overview paper presenting projected sensitivities for CASPEr Electric (axion-gluon EDM coupling g_d, Fig.3) and CASPEr Wind (axion-nucleon coupling g_aNN, Fig.4). These are sensitivity projections, not measured limits. Numerical data only available as shaded regions in figures (Fig.3, Fig.4) that cannot be reliably digitized from the text. Fig.4 plots g_aNN in GeV^-1 (a non-standard convention; the dimensionless g_an would require multiplying by a nucleon mass scale). The paper covers both AxionEDM (CASPEr Electric) and AxionNeutron (CASPEr Wind) — coupling type is ambiguous between the two branches, hence reduced confidence.
